name: Mississippi Delta — injected 95 min AIS blackout
note: CONTROLLED INJECTION. Same real Sentinel-1 scene and same real MarineCadastre AIS as gulf20230620, with exactly one change: GULF DAWN (MMSI 367005130) had its own existing 35 min reporting gap extended to 95 min by deleting its AIS rows between 01:06:35 and 02:40:00. Nothing else was altered - the U-Net detection, the drift, and all 239 other vessel tracks are identical. On the unaltered scene the system declines (top score 0.577, margin 0.064 < 0.08). Here it accuses at 0.684 with a margin of 0.171. This is the only honest way to test attribution: no public dataset carries verified spill-to-vessel truth.
